# Kellam Trademark Law

> Kellam Trademark Law is a North Carolina law firm focused on federal trademark registration and prosecution. Attorney John Kellam assists businesses, founders, and brand owners. The firm is based in Wake County and serves clients in the Research Triangle and greater Wilmington areas.

The website contains information about the firm, its services, and federal trademark procedures. Educational articles provide general information rather than legal advice for a particular matter.

## Firm and contact

- [Home](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/): Overview of the firm and its trademark practice.
- [About John Kellam](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/about): Attorney background, education, and admission information.
- [Contact and consultations](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/contact): Contact information and consultation scheduling.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/faqs): General answers to common trademark questions.

## Trademark services

- [Trademark search and clearance](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/trademark-search-and-clearance): Evaluating proposed marks and potential conflicts.
- [Trademark applications](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/trademark-applications): Preparing and filing federal trademark applications.
- [USPTO office action responses](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/trademark-office-actions): Assistance with examination issues, refusals, and response strategy.
- [Trademark maintenance and renewal](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/trademark-maintenance-and-renewal): Post-registration filings and maintenance.
- [Trademark licensing](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/trademark-licensing): Agreements governing permission to use trademarks.
- [Trademark portfolio and brand strategy](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/trademark-portfolio-and-brand-strategy): Planning trademark protection and managing brand assets.

## Service areas

- [Raleigh and Research Triangle](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/raleigh-trademark-attorney): Trademark services for businesses in Raleigh and the Research Triangle.
- [Wilmington and surrounding communities](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/wilmington-trademark-attorney): Trademark services for businesses in the greater Wilmington area.

## Trademark articles

- [Trademark Insights](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/insights): Index of educational articles written by John Kellam.
- [How to Choose and Clear a Trademark Before Filing](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/articles/how-to-choose-and-clear-a-trademark-before-filing): Trademark strength, searches, related goods and services, and potential conflicts.
- [What Happens After You File a Federal Trademark Application?](https://kellamtrademarklaw.com/articles/what-happens-after-filing-a-federal-trademark-application): Examination, office actions, publication, and the registration process.
